title: Separate rainbow dust bunny emerges
must_move: Let exactly one rainbow dust bunny rise once from the cradle, with a small contained glow and no full-cast reveal.
must_not_move: arena, platform, lamps, clean Grand Puff topology, prismatic cradle, exact two-character count, and floor contacts
end_state: End on Puff beside the single bunny and cradle, both intact and calm, with no reconstituted boss or extra effects.
strict_reason: All current variants add full cast and an oversized rainbow creature/effect; the required post-FRIENDS coda is exactly one bunny emerging from a tiny cradle.
